title: One reviewer's verdict on whether its own findings were resolved

candidate.description: The post-fix commit these verdicts were formed against.

verdicts.description: One entry per finding this lens raised. A finding with no entry is unresolved: silence is never clearance.

resolved.description: True only after reading the changed code. The fixer's own report is bookkeeping and is not evidence.

evidence.description: What in the new diff settles it — the file and what it now does. For an unresolved finding, what is still wrong.
